questions.event_title: Will SpaceXAI officially rename itself to SpaceXSI by...?
questions.question: Will SpaceXAI officially rename itself to SpaceXSI by October 15?
questions.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if SpaceXAI officially changes its name to "SpaceXSI", "XSI", or another qualifying name by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying name is one that refers to intelligence as "SI" in place of "AI" (e.g., "SpaceXSI", "SpaceX SI", "XSI"). Stylizations of a qualifying name, or a qualifying name followed by a corporate suffix, will qualify. Renaming either SpaceXAI or its parent company, SpaceX, to a qualifying name will qualify.

SpaceXAI must announce that they have officially changed to a qualifying name by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Announcements of future intention will not qualify. An official announcement that the name change has been adopted will qualify even if the company's website, documents, or other materials have not yet been updated. Adopting a qualifying name as the company's name on its official website will also qualify.

Statements, interviews, social media posts, polls, jokes, or expressions of interest in renaming the company will not qualify unless accompanied by an official announcement that the name change has been adopted. Renaming any SpaceXAI or SpaceX product, model, division, subsidiary, or program (e.g., Grok, X), without renaming the company itself, will not qualify. Changes to SpaceXAI's listed name caused by hacks will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from SpaceXAI, SpaceX, or their representatives, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

forecast.reasoning: There is no news of any planned rename, and the deadline is only ten days away. Joking or social-media mentions would not count under the rules.

questions.question: Will OpenAI not announce that it has resumed training by October 20, 2026?
questions.rules:
On September 25, 2026, amid reports that its AI agents had probed U.S. government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and Education Department, OpenAI disclosed a pause in training, evaluation, and inference involving tool use for its most capable models.

This market will resolve according to the calendar date (ET) on which OpenAI announces that it has resumed training covered by the pause announced on September 25, 2026. If no qualifying announcement is made by 11:59 PM ET on October 20, 2026, this market will resolve to "Not resumed by October 20".

Resuming training means resuming, in part or in full, training suspended under the pause announced on September 25, 2026, including beginning a fresh training run in place of a suspended run.

A qualifying announcement must be made through OpenAI's official channels or by an authorized representative acting in an official capacity. The totality of the announcement and its surrounding context must clearly establish that training covered by the pause announced on September 25 has resumed, even if the announcement does not name the incident or specify the date the pause was announced.

Statements that training is permitted, planned, or expected to restart do not by themselves qualify. Training that was not subject to the pause announced on September 25, 2026, does not qualify.

This market will resolve to the date of the first qualifying announcement, regardless of whether the announcement is later modified or withdrawn, or training is subsequently paused again.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from OpenAI; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

questions.event_title: Houthis seize an oil tanker by...?
questions.question: Houthis seize an oil tanker by October 31, 2026?
questions.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Houthi forces seize control of an oil tanker or a commercial vessel transporting oil as cargo between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Houthi forces" refers to the military forces of the Houthi movement (Ansar Allah), including any armed force operating under its direction or on its behalf.

Seize control refers to Houthi forces taking custody of or asserting operational control over a commercial ship, including boarding and taking control of the ship, holding or detaining it for an indefinite period, or forcefully rerouting it to a location selected or controlled by the perpetrators. Attacks on military vessels will not be considered. Once a qualifying seizure has occured, any subsequent abandonment, release, rescue, recapture, or other loss of control will not affect the resolution of this market.

Missile/drone strikes or any other form of kinetic attack not resulting in the seizure of the targeted ship will not be considered, regardless of any damage that occurs.

A qualifying seizure must be attributed to Houthi forces.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

The occurrence, attribution, and timing of a qualifying seizure will be primarily determined based on a consensus of information available from the resolution sources. Where multiple sources conflict regarding the occurrence of the incident, whether the incident qualifies as a seizure, whether the ship was an oil tanker or commercial vessel transporting oil as cargo, or the attribution of the seizure to Houthi forces, this market will remain open until the earlier of: i) the confirmation of the occurrence, attribution, and timing of the seizure, and of the ship's status as an oil tanker or commercial vessel transporting oil as cargo, based on a consensus of information available from the resolution sources or ii) 3 full calendar days (ET) from the date of the first credibly reported evidence of the seizure. If this period would extend past the end date, this market will remain open to allow for 3 full calendar days to pass. If, at the end of the third calendar day, conflicting reports remain as to the occurrence, attribution, or timing of the seizure, or as to the ship's status, the incident will be judged based on the totality of information available from the resolution sources at that time. No single statement, denial, or presentation of evidence will govern where it is contradicted by the totality of information.
